{{Quote|Just once, I'd like to destroy a starship that ''we'' didn't pay for!|[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hurkk]] at the [[Battle of Oovo IV|Battle of]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]|<ref name="NEGTVV" />}}
The '''EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate''' was a 300-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for use by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], to protect convoys from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] actions. It was, however, used more famously by the Rebellion.

==Characteristics==
The standard Nebulon-B [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was armed with twelve [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], twelve [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. It was designed to carry twenty-four [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters.

While generally well-armed for a vessel of that size, the midsection connecting spar was an exploitable vulnerability. It could be [[Provocateur|split open]] by concentrated heavy weapons fire, venting the frigate's atmosphere and killing most of the crew.

==History==
[[File:NebulonB_schem.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Nebulon-B [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
The EF76 was introduced as a counterinsurgency ship late in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It largely phased out the [[Class-C frigate/Legends|Class-C frigate]]. The Nebulon-B was originally designed to defend [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoys against raids by Rebel starfighters, as the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] wasn't keen on the idea of relegating its expensive [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] to escort duty, and the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] were too weak and carried few, if any, TIE fighters.

The EF76 was used extensively by both sides in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The frigate was known and respected for its efficiency against fighters and [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and its anti-fighter assignment in Imperial convoys had an immediate impact, causing the Rebels to reconsider their hyperspace raids after suffering irreplaceable losses in fighters and pilots. They were often used to support larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], such as [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and Rebel [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]].

In their starfleets, Imperial Admirals [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] often used Nebulon-B frigates as command ships in lieu of the standard Star Destroyer.

===Rebel usage===
{{Quote|They're heading for the medical frigate!|Wedge Antilles during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
Before the formal founding of the Rebel Alliance, the escort frigate [[Resurgence (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Resurgence'']] was used by the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] forces allied with [[Alya Aldrete]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="A Reckoning of Wraiths">{{DoD|A Reckoning of Wraiths}}</ref>

[[File:EF76NEBBfrigate-Chron.png|thumb|left|180px|A Nebulon-B escort [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]]]
The Rebel Alliance also acquired a number of these ships through defection, capturing them in battle, or by outright theft. Indeed, one of their first flagships was a Nebulon-B captured in a skirmish over [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], which they christened the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. The Rebels were not the only ones beyond the Empire to acquire Nebulon-B frigates. It was rumored that [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] Drive Yards would sell the frigates to interested third parties through secret fronts so as not to upset the Imperial Navy. The sale price was 19,400,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], cited as a twentieth of the cost of an ''Imperial''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The Rebels' usage of the Nebulon-B was extensive enough that, during the [[Battle of Oovo IV]], Imperial Admiral [[Hurkk]] once expressed irritation and pled that the Imperial fleet, if only once, could destroy a Rebel-owned starship that the Imperials did not originally pay for.<ref name="NEGTVV" />

The Rebels found other uses for the ships which took advantage of their sophisticated [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and deep-space multifrequency antennas. Escort frigates were used as long-range scouts or search and rescue ships, or to relay information to [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] during battle. In small, shorthanded Rebel task forces, Nebulon-B frigates often served as command ships. One Nebulon-B, the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], served the Alliance as their primary hospital ship.

All available Rebel Nebulon-B frigates were deployed at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where they took a pivotal part in the battle. The ''Redemption'' was lost to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|superlaser]].

The frigates were also used by the Rebellion's successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DE" />

==Variants==
[[File:NebBengines_btm.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The Nebulon-B [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''Redemption'']]
The Rebels converted some of their Nebulon-B frigates into [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical vessels]], which served as mobile hospitals. Weaponry and hangar space was sacrificed to make room for treatment facilities, 15 bacta tanks, 745 beds, and other hospital suites.<ref name="SWTJ">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref> The crew was slightly modified to include an additional 80 medical personnel and 30 medical droids (such as the [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] model).<ref name="SWTJ" /> These ships could not carry any fighters, and their armament was reduced to 6 turbolasers (with computer-assisted targeting) and 8 laser cannons. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was treated for the injuries he [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|suffered]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on board the medical frigate ''Redemption''.

Kuat Drive Yards eventually produced an improved version of the Nebulon-B, the [[Nebulon-B2 frigate|Nebulon-B2]]. They were similar overall, but had higher sublight speed, improved shields and hull armor, a thicker connecting spar, and additional weaponry.

Following the Battle of Endor, Kuat Drive Yards followed up on its successful Nebulon-B design with a new starship class, the 275-meter-long [[Corona-class frigate|''Corona''-class frigate]]. ''Corona''-class frigates were produced solely for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Because Corona frigates were not part of the New Republic's [[New Class Modernization Program]], orders for the ships remained modest. A number of them served in the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

At least one EF76 was used to make up a secret retreat in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="SWL25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref> The criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] used such a frigate around this time, where it was stationed near [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Lun Rask]]'s [[Tibanna gas platform|headquarters]] over [[Kaer]].<ref name="SWL37" /> At least one was used during the [[Evacuation of Dac]].

==Behind the scenes==
The shape of the Nebulon-B, designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], was inspired by an outboard motor.

In the ''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Vehicles'', the entry for the Nebulon-B Frigate is erroneously referred to as a "Rebel Cruiser," which can lead it to be confused with [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]. Most sources commonly refer to it as "Nebulon-B Frigate" or "Escort Frigate."

[[File:Nebulon-b_negvv.png|thumb|right|180px|A Nebulon-B]]

There is some dispute among fans on the claimed fighter capacity of the Nebulon-B. Computer games and the deck plans in ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'' show a hangar in the forward hull, with a launch aperture in the starboard flank, but there seems to be no such opening on the model used in the movies. Other depictions in the computer games show starfighters docking and launching via an opening in the thin connection between the superstructure and drive bay.

However, the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', seemingly the source which first introduced the Nebulon-B's starfighter capability, mentions no internal hangars. The text simply says: "The escort frigate has the capacity to carry up to two squadrons of starfighters into battle. In addition, the ship has docking fixtures to accommodate ships of up to medium freighter size" (p. 60). Since [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] shows the "docking fixtures" to be external hardpoints on the spar between the prow superstructure and engines, it is possible that the fighters could also be carried on a rack along the spar, in the manner of [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruisers]], [[Assault frigate/Legends|assault frigates]], and ''[[FarStar]]''.

Additionally, some fans have speculated that some Nebulon-Bs could have been equipped with an enclosed hangar bay fitted under the spar, filling the space between the forward keel and the engine block. Perhaps added as aftermarket additions, such hangars would enable them to carry fighters like [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] more comfortably, and ''[[Kalla's Stanchion]]'', a ship that could belong to this subtype of the class, has appeared in Rebel Alliance hands in [[Empire 22|issue 22]] of ''[[Star Wars: Empire]]''. Although scaling extrapolations when compared with snubfighters shown in the same panels would suggest a size significantly larger than the 300m-long Nebulon-B, the two designs correspond closely in appearance, and the size discrepancy may simply be a result of artistic license in the comic-book art. Footage from the game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' depicts the Nebulon-B frigate ''Salvation'' dwarfing the 65-meter ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' by an order of magnitude.
